notes.title: Operation: Night Strikers Day, Aug 15th in Akihabara!
notes.content:
[h1][b]All units: converge on Akihabara![/b][/h1]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41309941/af01ee55df0eb91e34050fde7363d4add814e8a4.png[/img]
On August 15, we’re holding a special Night Striker-focused event above the Hey arcade in Akihabara, Tokyo. The venue will feature merchandise sales—including limited and early-release items—an actual arcade Night Striker cabinet on display, and a hands-on play area.

In the morning, we’ll host the “Night Striker Special Tactical Action Force Skills Trial in Hey” competition. Players will take on designated stages, competing for the highest Running Point score (displayed on the game’s gadget) at stage end. Entry is limited to 20 participants; if applications exceed this number, players will be selected at random. Those wishing to participate should register at the Hey 2F counter between 10:00 and 10:15 on the day of the event.

At 15:00, we present the “Monthly ZUNTATA NIGHT – Special Summer 2025 Edition in Hey”. Guests will include M2 development staff from Operation Night Strikers and Night Striker GEAR, showcasing live gameplay and delivering talks from the sound creators. The session will also be streamed live on YouTube—so if you can’t attend in person, join us online!
[p][url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BqSo6EPjoL8"]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BqSo6EPjoL8[/url]([i]Stream available in Japanese only.[/i])[/p]

notes.title: Space Invaders Day Score Contest Results!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31726863/54585fe2504bfa88b976fa891da3d242936dc252.png[/img]
Well, we had quite a battle at the weekend!
I thought TaosukeFox had clinched it with their 3.9m score, but then wr01r came in at 4m+ and an even higher score of 4.2m near the end, but fogg_manatic snuck in at the end with a staggering 5 million points! mtyankovich in 3rd climbed from 3m to over 4m, securing themelves 3rd place overall.

The full game saw a score rush too, perhaps most impressive of all being sciencer0122 managing to top their own previous number 1 score! However, equally impressive were out 2nd and 3rd entries who lept from the 2m point mark to well over 3m, securing themselves top placing!

We'll contact the Trial contest winners through Twitter, and the full game winners via Steam (look out for a friend request from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198296686560/]this account[/url]), but for now, a big thank you to everyone who took part!

Top 5 for each contest below:

[b]Trial Version[/b]
[list]
[*]1st 5,078,900 @fogg_manatic
[*]2nd 4,272,000 @wr01r
[*]3rd 4,071,300 @mtyankovich
[*]4th 3,931,350 @TaosukeFox
[*]5th 3,759,200 @jackassforce
[/list]

[b]Full Game[/b]
[list]
[*]1st 3,864,350 sciencer0122
[*]2nd 3,249,700 foolin
[*]3rd 3,178,500 Sir Moovenstein
[*]4th 3,040,800 Soyokaze
[*]5th 2,898,050 men_gunners
[/list]

notes.title: Space Invaders Day Score Contest!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31726863/a40c45f21595bc92a579b2232d524728b31fd1d7.png[/img]

That's right, June 16th is Space Invaders Day, commemorating the day when that classic game was first active in arcades 40 years ago. And to celebrate it, there's a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/838400/Space_Invaders_Extreme_Demo]free demo[/url] (play the first two stages!) out today, a discount available for the game and two score contests with prizes to be won!

[h1]Dates:[/h1]
6/14 (Thurs) 6pm ~ 6/17 (Sun) 6pm (PST)

[h1]Contest 1: Trial Edition Rules[/h1]
[olist][*]Download the Trial version, play until the end of Stage 2A
[*]Take a screenshot of the result screen (F12)
[*]Tweet your screenshot to [url=https://twitter.com/DegicaGames]@degicagames[/url] with #spaceinvaders (tell us what you enjoyed about the game too!)
[*]Multiple entries OK! Only entries made between the dates above will be valid.
[/olist]

Result Screen:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31726863/0c9799bef322d060fe396502cb1874c747e8a380.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31726863/d28500aab3e800b6601b48e8e5f4d706c4c5dbd7.png[/img][/url]

[b]Prizes:[/b]
Top three scores will receive a Steam key for Space Invaders Extreme.

[h1]Contest 2: Extreme Edition Rules[/h1]
[olist][*]Play through Stage 1A on Free Play mode and record your score
[*]Multiple entries OK! Only scores recorded (or updated) between the dates above will be valid.[/olist]

[b]Prizes:[/b]
[list][*]1st: Signed SIE poster
[*]2nd: Exclusive decal sticker
[*]3rd: Exclusive SIE sticker[/list]

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31726863/d5f59a0cac896af4124bbf5b15135dc33f6885fd.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31726863/0bd5b72d83ab2557fe56c46a4f45fe69325ba433.jpg[/img][/url]

Small print:
In order to deliver prizes, we will need to contact winners via either Twitter, email or Steam. Our [url=https://degica.com/privacy.html]Privacy Policy[/url], for reference.

Grab the demo here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/838400/Space_Invaders_Extreme_Demo
